about: T-431 P1, feelings in the game (2026-10-21): stored in each daemon's unused contest-condition bytes, pushed by play, fading with a 3-hour half-life, shown on DEBUG -> GAME EVENTS -> FEELINGS. An old save's daemons read zero; a battle won pushes the one who fought; a loss pushes the whole party (and the white-out's heal does not calm it: only a heal the player chooses does); a CHECKPOINT heal calms; +3 HOURS halves every value; an egg is never pushed; an in-game trade's condition bytes read as zero; a day in a box comes back sad; twelve hours in one, a little sad. The theatre's debug scratch save; nothing is saved.

stops.stop: an old save's daemons read zero (and slot 5 is made an egg)
steps: feelings party 0 set=0 glad=0 mad=0 sad=0 calm=0

stops.stop: a battle won: the daemon that fought is glad, the rest untouched
steps: feelings party 0 set=1 glad>=8 mad=0 sad=0

stops.stop: a battle lost: the whole party sad, cross and afraid -- and the white-out's heal leaves it afraid (no calm push)
steps: feelings party 2 set=1 sad>=12 mad>=6 glad=0 calm=-10

stops.stop: a CHECKPOINT heal: calmer, and the follower goes into the machine and comes back
+3 HOURS: every value half what it was
an in-game trade's condition bytes read as zero (the egg hatched by hand; its bytes written as trade_scene.c does)
steps: feelings party 4 set=0 glad=0 mad=0 sad=0 calm=0
feelings party 4 set=1 glad=0 mad=0 sad=0 calm>=19 calm<=21

stops.stop: a day in a box: deposited (restamped), a day passes, withdrawn sadder and a little afraid
steps: feelings box 13 0 glad=0 mad=0 sad=0 calm=0
feelings party 5 set=1 glad=0 mad=0 sad=10 calm=-5

stops.stop: twelve hours in a box: withdrawn a little sad (sad +6 on what is left)
steps: feelings party 5 set=1 sad>=6 sad<=8 calm>=0
